mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP indicates strong economic demand, which positively impacts corporate earnings and drives S&P 500 forward returns higher over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not higher than baseline during GDP growth periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 6% signals a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and higher S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Forward returns are negative when UNRATE is below 6% more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When both PAYEMS (employment) increases and UNRATE decreases, it indicates a robust labor market, boosting corporate revenues and S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: No positive correlation between labor market improvement and S&P 500 returns (correlation < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in FEDFUNDS above 4% tightens monetary policy, reducing liquidity and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Positive 20-day returns occur more than 30% of the time when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising CPIAUCSL (inflation) leads to higher interest rates, which negatively impacts equity valuations and S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 shows positive 5-day returns during high inflation periods (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 95 indicates strong supply activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Forward returns are not higher when INDPRO exceeds 95 (Mann-Whitney U test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When both GDPC1 and RSAFS increase, it signals strong demand, leading to higher S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: No positive correlation between demand indicators and S&P 500 returns (correlation < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a strong housing market, boosting related sectors and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Forward returns are negative when HOUST exceeds 50 more than 40% of the time.
